description: This file is a shell script for managing LED states during different system boot and recovery stages in OpenWrt. It sources external functions from leds.sh, and defines functions to set LED states based on system status.

methods.name: set_led_state
methods.description: Sets the LED state based on the input parameter, managing blinking, on, or off states for different boot phases.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Determines whether to invoke set_led_state based on the presence of certain system statuses.
